Now admittedly I'm not scared of halloween or parties and the like, but that's not to say that there aren't situations like that where I would be extremely uncomfortable. You'll never find me going to a "club" (the kind with the dancing, drinks, and loud music). They're made for extreme socialites, and I get sick to my stomach thinking about what I'd do if I were pressured into going to one. Heck, just going to a bar for the first time when I turned 21 was a big step for me (though my love for alcohol definitely outweighs any social anxiety that I would feel from such situations now).

That many words to say, a lot of growing experiences have been from friends pressuring me to do so (and 90% of the time things worked out great). But sometimes there were things that they really wanted me to like that I could never get into, and just trying to felt really awkward and unnatural for me. Sometimes I'd even be decent at the thing we were trying (if it was something skill inclined), but it just wasn't really for me in the end.
